name: bento-reveal
title: Bento Reveal
description: A modular grid of mixed-size tiles that enter in reading order with a short stagger the first time the grid scrolls in.

meta.reducedMotion: Tiles are visible from the start.
meta.useWhen: Content that truly has mixed weights (one big feature, several small facts).
meta.avoidWhen: Equal-weight content (use a list); as the default landing layout (it's overused); more than one per page.
